entities.name: Bordeaux–Irun railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The railway from Bordeaux to Irun is an important French 235-kilometre long railway line, that connects the southwestern city Bordeaux to northern Spain. The railway was opened in several stages between 1841 and 1864.
